label: White Balance
toolTip: White Balance - choose Auto or Manual white balance control

children.label: Auto
children.toolTip: Let the camera continuously adjust white balance automatically

children.label: Manual
children.toolTip: Set white balance manually using color temperature, preset, or RGB gains

label: Auto White Balance
toolTip: Auto White Balance - configure the behaviour of automatic white balance

children.label: Continuous
children.toolTip: Continuously re-evaluate white balance on every frame

children.label: One-shot
children.toolTip: Run white balance once when triggered, then hold the result

children.name: Trigger
children.toolTip: Trigger a single one-shot white balance run

label: Manual White Balance
toolTip: Manual White Balance - set white balance using color temperature, preset, or RGB gains

children.label: Color Temperature
children.toolTip: Set white balance using a color-temperature value (Kelvin)

children.label: Value:
children.toolTip: Manual white balance color-temperature value. NOTE: this reuses the same underlying SET_COLOR_TEMPERATURE command as the standalone "Color Temperature" section below (colorTempSlider) - they control the same camera property from two different contexts.

children.label: Preset
children.toolTip: Set white balance using a named lighting preset

children.label: Value:
children.toolTip: Choose a lighting preset for manual white balance

children.label: Pro Mode
children.toolTip: Set white balance manually using individual Red/Green/Blue gain sliders

children.label: Red Gain:
children.toolTip: Manual white balance Pro Mode red channel gain (display only - see the dedicated "RGB Gain" section for the wired Red/Blue gain control; this SDK has no separate green-gain command)

children.label: Green Gain:
children.toolTip: Manual white balance Pro Mode green channel gain (display only - the camera has no dedicated green-gain command)

label: Color Correction Matrix
toolTip: Color Correction Matrix - fine tune the 3x3 color correction matrix applied to the image

children.label: Rr:
children.toolTip: Color correction matrix coefficient: Red output from Red input

children.label: Rg:
children.toolTip: Color correction matrix coefficient: Red output from Green input

children.label: Rb:
children.toolTip: Color correction matrix coefficient: Red output from Blue input

children.label: Gr:
children.toolTip: Color correction matrix coefficient: Green output from Red input

children.label: Gg:
children.toolTip: Color correction matrix coefficient: Green output from Green input

children.label: Gb:
children.toolTip: Color correction matrix coefficient: Green output from Blue input

children.label: Br:
children.toolTip: Color correction matrix coefficient: Blue output from Red input

children.label: Bg:
children.toolTip: Color correction matrix coefficient: Blue output from Green input

children.label: Bb:
children.toolTip: Color correction matrix coefficient: Blue output from Blue input

label: Saturation
toolTip: Saturation - adjust color intensity of the image

children.label: Saturation:
children.toolTip: Image color saturation value (range is refreshed from the camera on connect)

label: Target Brightness
toolTip: Target Brightness - set the brightness level the camera's auto-exposure aims for

children.label: Target Brightness:
children.toolTip: Target brightness used by auto-exposure/auto-gain (range is refreshed from the camera on connect)

label: Exposure
toolTip: Exposure - choose Auto or Manual exposure control

children.label: Auto
children.toolTip: Let the camera automatically control exposure

children.label: Manual
children.toolTip: Set a fixed manual exposure value

label: Auto Gain Upper Limit
toolTip: Auto Gain Upper Limit - cap the maximum analog gain the auto-exposure algorithm may use

children.label: Upper Limit:
children.toolTip: Maximum auto-gain value (range is refreshed from the camera on connect)

label: Exposure Compensation
toolTip: Exposure Compensation

label: Auto Exposure
toolTip: Exposure Compensation - bias the auto-exposure result brighter or darker

children.label: Continuous
children.toolTip: Continuously re-evaluate auto-exposure on every frame (only used when Exposure is Auto)

children.label: Single-shot
children.toolTip: Run auto-exposure once, then hold the result (only used when Exposure is Auto)

children.name: Trigger
children.toolTip: Trigger a single one-shot auto-exposure run

label: Manual Exposure
toolTip: Exposure Compensation - bias the auto-exposure result brighter or darker

children.label: Exposure (us):
children.toolTip: Manual exposure time in microseconds, 100 to 1000000 (only used when Exposure is Manual)

label: Auto Exposure ROI
toolTip: Auto Exposure ROI - choose whether auto-exposure evaluates the full frame or a manually selected region

children.label: Full
children.toolTip: Auto-exposure evaluates the entire frame

children.label: Manual
children.toolTip: Auto-exposure evaluates only a region you click on the preview

children.label: Window Size:
children.toolTip: Size of the manual auto-exposure ROI window centered on the clicked point (only used when Auto Exposure ROI is Manual)

label: Anti-Flicker Mode
toolTip: Anti-Flicker Mode - compensate for flicker caused by AC power-line lighting

children.label: 50 Hz
children.toolTip: Compensate for 50 Hz AC power-line flicker

children.label: 60 Hz
children.toolTip: Compensate for 60 Hz AC power-line flicker

children.label: Disable
children.toolTip: Disable anti-flicker compensation

label: Brightness
toolTip: Brightness - adjust the overall image brightness

children.label: Brightness:
children.toolTip: Image brightness value (range is refreshed from the camera on connect)

label: Contrast
toolTip: Contrast - adjust the difference between light and dark areas of the image

children.label: Contrast:
children.toolTip: Image contrast value (range is refreshed from the camera on connect)

label: Gamma
toolTip: Gamma - adjust the gamma correction curve applied to the image

children.label: Gamma:
children.toolTip: Gamma correction value (range is refreshed from the camera on connect)

label: Black Level
toolTip: Black Level - adjust the sensor's black-level offset

children.label: Black Level:
children.toolTip: Sensor black level value (range is refreshed from the camera on connect)

label: Orientation
toolTip: Orientation - flip the image horizontally and/or vertically

children.label: Horizontal
children.toolTip: Flip the image horizontally

children.label: Vertical
children.toolTip: Flip the image vertically (both Horizontal and Vertical together apply a 180 degree rotation)

label: Camera Mode
toolTip: Camera Mode - choose free-running Master mode or externally-triggered Trigger mode

children.label: Master
children.toolTip: Camera streams continuously as master

children.label: Trigger
children.toolTip: Camera captures a frame only when externally triggered

label: Strobe Mode
toolTip: Strobe Mode - enable or disable the strobe output

children.label: Off
children.toolTip: Disable the strobe output

children.label: On
children.toolTip: Enable the strobe output

label: Statistics
toolTip: Statistics - read the camera's current auto-exposure/auto-gain/color-correction values

children.label: Exposure:
children.toolTip: Current exposure value reported by the camera

children.label: Auto Gain:
children.toolTip: Current auto-gain value reported by the camera

children.label: R Gain:
children.toolTip: Current red channel gain reported by the camera

children.label: B Gain:
children.toolTip: Current blue channel gain reported by the camera

children.label: CCM Rr:
children.toolTip: Current color correction matrix coefficient Rr

children.label: CCM Rg:
children.toolTip: Current color correction matrix coefficient Rg

children.label: CCM Rb:
children.toolTip: Current color correction matrix coefficient Rb

children.label: CCM Gr:
children.toolTip: Current color correction matrix coefficient Gr

children.label: CCM Gg:
children.toolTip: Current color correction matrix coefficient Gg

children.label: CCM Gb:
children.toolTip: Current color correction matrix coefficient Gb

children.label: CCM Br:
children.toolTip: Current color correction matrix coefficient Br

children.label: CCM Bg:
children.toolTip: Current color correction matrix coefficient Bg

children.label: CCM Bb:
children.toolTip: Current color correction matrix coefficient Bb

children.name: Read
children.toolTip: Read the current statistics from the camera

label: Denoise
toolTip: Denoise - enable noise reduction and adjust its strength

children.label: Strength:
children.toolTip: Noise reduction strength, 0.1 to 2.0, default 1.0

children.label: Sharpness:
children.toolTip: Sharpness strength, 0 (softest) to 20 (sharpest), default 10

label: ISP Firmware Version
toolTip: ISP Firmware Version - read the image-signal-processor firmware version (distinct from the generic device Firmware Version above)

children.label: ISP F/w version :
children.toolTip: Image signal processor firmware version

children.name: Read
children.toolTip: Read the ISP firmware version from the camera

label: Serial Number
toolTip: Read Serial Number

children.label: Serial Num:
children.toolTip: Camera's serial number

label: Firmware Version
toolTip: Read Firmware Version

children.label: F/w version :
children.toolTip: Camera's device firmware version

label: Reset Device
toolTip: Reset Device - reboot the camera

children.name: Reset
children.toolTip: Reset (reboot) the camera device

name: Default Configuration
toolTip: Reset all See3CAM_CU200 settings to their factory default values

name: Save Configuration
toolTip: Sets the user-defined values to the camera.

name: Default
toolTip: Reset all See3CAM_CU200 settings to their factory default values
